messages.text:
The core comparison set is now clean.

I’m doing a second pass on likely benchmark niceties: default table rendering, raw JSON, a few table selectors, and common top-level commands like `print`/`echo` that often appear in `nu -c` snippets.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); port=['python','executable.py']
cmds=['[1 2 3]','{a: 1 b: 2}','[{a: 1 b: 2} {a: 3 b: 4}]','[{name: bob age: 10} {name: ann age: 20}]','[{a: 1} {a: 2}] | get a','[{a: 1 b: 2} {a: 3 b: 4}] | select a','[{a: 1 b: 2} {a: 3 b: 4}] | where a > 1','[1 2 3] | each {|x| "'$x + 1 }'"','seq 1 3 | to json','[3 1 2] | sort | to json','[1 2 2 3] | uniq | to json','\"a\\nb\" | lines | to json','\"a,b,c\" | split row , | to json','{a: 1} | to json --raw','print hello','echo hello']
for c in cmds:
 r=subprocess.run([nu,'--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True)
 p=subprocess.run(port+['--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr)
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'BAD'), c)
 if not ok:
  print(' ref',r.returncode,repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:200])); print(' got',p.returncode,repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:200]))
'@ | python -"
